record.paper_title: Some Open Questions on Anti-de Sitter Geometry
record.context_brief: Geometric detection of proper actions on AdS^3
record.original_question: Let S be the interior of a compact surface with boundary, let h_l and h_r be complete convex cocompact hyperbolic metrics on S, and let ρ_l,ρ_r : π_1(S) → PSL_2(R) be the corresponding holonomies. How can one detect geometrically whether the action of (ρ_l,ρ_r)(π_1(S)) on AdS^3 is proper or non-proper from the hyperbolic metrics on the boundary components of the convex core or from the bending laminations?

evidence.quote: Question 7.1. Let hl, hr ∈ TS and let ρl, ρr : π1(S) → PSL2(R) be the corresponding holonomies. How can one read the properness or non-properness of the action of (ρl, ρr)(π1(S)) on AdS3: • on the hyperbolic metrics of the boundary components of the convex core? • on the bending laminations?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ be the interior of a compact orientable surface with non-empty boundary, and let $h_\ell, h_r$ be two complete convex cocompact hyperbolic metrics on $S$. Denote by $\rho_\ell, \rho_r : \pi_1(S) \to \mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{R})$ the corresponding holonomy representations, and consider the diagonal representation
$$ (\rho_\ell, \rho_r) : \pi_1(S) \longrightarrow \mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{R}) \times \mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{R}) \cong \mathrm{Isom}_0(\mathrm{AdS}^3). $$
For each of $i \in \{\ell, r\}$, the convex core of $(S, h_i)$ is a compact subsurface whose boundary components carry an induced hyperbolic metric and a bending measured geodesic lamination.

Provide geometric criteria, expressed purely in terms of either
(a) the induced hyperbolic metrics on the boundary components of the convex cores of $(S,h_\ell)$ and $(S,h_r)$, or
(b) the bending measured laminations on those boundary components,
that determine whether the action of $(\rho_\ell, \rho_r)(\pi_1(S))$ on $\mathrm{AdS}^3$ is properly discontinuous or not.
artifact.status_search_result: A direct search did not turn up a published resolution of this specific question (geometric detection of properness of the AdS³ action via boundary metrics or bending laminations of the convex cores). Related advances exist on properness of the bending map and on properness criteria for AdS³ actions (e.g., in the convex cocompact / quasi-Fuchsian setting) but none directly answers the question as stated. Status appears to remain unresolved, but evidence is inconclusive.

status_evidence.title: Properness of the bending map
status_evidence.snippet: Shows the bending map sending a convex cocompact hyperbolic structure to its bending measured lamination is proper.
status_evidence.claim: Related result on bending laminations, but does not address detecting properness of AdS^3 actions.

status_evidence.title: Convex co-compact hyperbolic manifolds are determined by their pleating lamination
status_evidence.snippet: Uniqueness of convex cocompact structures from pleating lamination data.
status_evidence.claim: Adjacent to question (b) but in the hyperbolic 3-manifold setting, not AdS^3 properness.
